title: A coarse screening k-grid interpolates garbage EXX/GW at band-path points off the mesh
symptom: BN 3D GW band path: EXX at a path midpoint ~ -106 eV, GW bandgap negative for nfreq=8/16, and a QPE iteration oscillating between two roots for 10000 iterations at nfreq=24 - while the uniform-mesh stage was clean.
root_cause: A 2x2x2 screening mesh cannot interpolate midpoints between Gamma and X; the corruption is in the producer-side sampling, not the frequency grid or the continuation.
minimal_fix: Raise the screening mesh (4x4x4 changed only KPT_scf: EXX recovered 22.28 eV, GW gap 6.24478 eV) and validate with a strict single-variable k control under identical protocol.
validation: k222 -> k444 same-protocol control: gap -132.38 -> 6.27089 eV.
avoid: Attributing path-stage failures to nfreq or Padé order before checking the k-grid; mixing protocol changes into the k control.

parameters.screening_kgrid: raise until path-midpoint EXX is physical (2x2x2 -> 4x4x4)
